settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Create an app in Spotify's developer dashboard with the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:43110/callback and Web API ticked, then paste its Client ID here.

settings.label: Translate lyrics with AI
settings.help: When LRCLIB has no synced lyrics in your language, send the original lyrics to the AI service below for translation. Off by default.

settings.label: AI Base URL
settings.help: An OpenAI-compatible Responses API base URL, such as https://api.openai.com/v1.

settings.label: AI API Key
settings.help: Sent only to the AI Base URL above, as an Authorization: Bearer header.

settings.label: AI Model
settings.help: The model name used by that Responses API.
